verdict.summary: Mobile health app potentially non-compliant with data protection regulations due to handling sensitive personal data.

issues.title: Lack of Explicit Regulations
issues.description: There are no explicit regulations addressing the specific combination of features (heart rate and location tracking) in any region.
issues.impact: Potential fines under various data protection regulations.
issues.remediation: Further research and analysis are required to identify applicable regulations and address any compliance gaps.

evidence_cited.content: Article 6 - Lawfulness of processing: 1. Processing shall be lawful only if and to the extent that at least one of the following applies:
Business Purposes (Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.100(d)(1)(A)): Collect and sell personal information for a business or commercial purpose.
